pending_interview.question: A large regional hospital network comes to you saying they want to "use AI to reduce patient no-shows." They have appointment scheduling data going back five years, basic EHR (electronic health record) data, and a small internal IT team. They have no existing AI infrastructure. How would you scope and structure a first engagement with them — and how would you decide whether to recommend building a custom solution, buying an off-the-shelf tool, or starting with something even simpler?
